statement.notes: The only field requested for extraction from the provided schema is 'depreciation_and_amortization'. This value is directly provided as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income to net cash provided by operating activities' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for all three years. No combination of elements is required. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease details) but do not provide alternative or component values for the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure reported in the primary statement.
